g.text: BODY SUPPORT — PIVOT, SIDEBEARERS AND RETENTION
C5 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · MILLIMETRES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY — NOT FOR FABRICATION
C31 collar included. Rear/standard-coach track uses the plain, unrelieved mounting variant.
The annular spherical bearing carries compression. The separate kingpin, lower washer, M50 nut and cross keeper retain
uplift. Four sleeved M16 body bolts and external cheeks connect the 18 mm adapter to the existing bolster. Floor hatches
Two compliant cartridges stabilize roll through bronze sliding shoes. Zero running gap and 1000 N/mm are development
requirements, not a measured rubber law. Body-tilt analysis uses the actual sphere centre and a 2° resultant cone.
2° is a resultant tilt cone, not simultaneous independent ±2° roll and ±2° pitch. The yaw study is ±7°; no operating curve or track twist is accepted.
Front accessible left track pocket accommodates C31 collar underside 476.35. Rear / ordinary bolster attachment is a distinct plain-track variant.
20 mm cartridge compression is a procurement target. Equal-biaxial volume expansion is only a clearance probe; actual bulge/friction law must be tested.
Body-interface proof includes defined sensitivity cases; contact, prying, local HSS wall behavior, floor foot loading, weld procedure and fatigue remain open.
